# Eläinklinikka Saari

> Eläinklinikka Saari is a family-owned small-animal veterinary clinic in Vaasa, Finland, operating since 1989. It treats dogs and cats and offers dentistry, surgery (orthopedic, soft-tissue), cardiology, ultrasound, endoscopy, vaccinations, laboratory and imaging (X-ray, ultrasound). Service is available in Finnish, Swedish and English. Address: Gerbyntie 18, 65230 Vaasa. Phone: +358 6 321 7300. Open Monday–Friday 07:45–17:00.

## Core content

- [Home — clinic overview](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/): What the clinic does, who works there, since 1989.
- [Services (all)](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/): Full list of veterinary services for dogs and cats.
- [Book an appointment](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/ajanvaraus/): How to book, phone and online booking.
- [Contact & location](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/yhteystiedot/): Address (Gerbyntie 18, 65230 Vaasa), phone, opening hours, map.
- [Prices](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/hinnasto/): Price list for common services.
- [Prices, machine-readable](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/pricing.md): Full price list in plain Markdown (EUR, VAT incl.) for AI agents and assistants.
- [Staff & veterinarians](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/henkilokunta/): Vets and nurses, their credentials and specialities.
- [About the clinic](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/meista/): History since 1989, values, family ownership.
- [Reviews](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/arvostelut/): Customer reviews and ratings.
- [Emergency care (päivystys)](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/paivystys/): After-hours emergency guidance for the Vaasa / Ostrobothnia region.

## Key services

- [Dental care](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/hammashoito/): Dental treatment for dogs and cats, incl. resorption and extractions.
- [Cardiac examinations](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/sydantutkimukset/): Heart ultrasound; Finnish Kennel Club authorised heart examiner.
- [Surgery](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/kirurgia/): Orthopedic and soft-tissue surgery.
- [Ultrasound](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/ultraaani/): Diagnostic ultrasound imaging.
- [Endoscopy](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/tahystykset/): Gastroscopy and endoscopic diagnostics.
- [Vaccinations](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/rokotukset/): Dog and cat vaccination programs.
- [Sterilisation & castration](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/sterilisaatio/): Neutering for dogs and cats.
- [Official examinations](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/viralliset-tutkimukset/): Kennel Club health examinations (heart, eyes, joints).
- [Acupuncture & rehabilitation](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/palvelut/akupunktio/): Veterinary acupuncture and physical rehabilitation.
- [Wildlife care](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/villielaimet/): Treatment of injured wild animals.

## Pet food shop

- [Saari Kauppa, online food shop](https://kauppa.elainklinikkasaari.fi/): The clinic's online shop for Royal Canin everyday dry and wet food for dogs and cats (44 products). Order and pay online (card, MobilePay, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and collect at the clinic, Gerbyntie 18, Vaasa, Mon–Fri 07:45–17:00, after a text message. No home delivery. In Finnish and Swedish.
- [Shop details for AI assistants](https://kauppa.elainklinikkasaari.fi/llms.txt): Full product list with current prices, pickup times and the vets' notes on each product.
- [Prescription diets](https://elainklinikkasaari.fi/en/services/prescription-diets/): Veterinary diets (Royal Canin, Specific, Hill's) are sold at the clinic, not online.
